title: session.info_reply
description: Reply to session.info: one session's detail, merging live state (when running) with the registry record (when cold). Usage/turn fields are advisory — absence means "not known".

context_tokens.description: Tokens in context: the agent's latest ACP usage_update.used; else an approximate sum of the last turn's input-side usage.

context_window.description: Context window size from the agent's latest ACP usage_update.size; null when the agent never sent one.

last_turn_usage.description: The last turn's ACP PromptResponse.usage, verbatim (camelCase).

cumulative_usage.description: Per-key sum of every turn's ACP PromptResponse.usage (camelCase).
